Course progress课程进度

Lesson 1 · Geospatial data models and mapping第 1 讲 · 地理空间数据模型与制图

3 exercises

Vector and raster data models, geographic versus projected coordinate systems, and thematic mapping principles. Produced the first choropleths of Singapore's planning subzones, then went beyond the built-in classification methods to percentile and box maps whose breaks come from the data distribution itself.矢量与栅格数据模型、地理坐标系与投影坐标系的区别，以及专题制图的原则。先做出新加坡规划分区的首批分级统计图，再越过内置分级方法，改用断点直接取自数据分布本身的百分位图与箱式图。

Lesson 2 · Spatial point patterns analysis第 2 讲 · 空间点格局分析

2 exercises

First-order methods describing where events are dense, and second-order methods describing whether events attract or repel one another and at what distance. The headline result: Singapore's 1,925 childcare centres are strongly clustered, R = 0.552, and the pattern survives every test applied to it.一阶方法描述事件在哪里稠密，二阶方法描述事件之间是相互吸引还是排斥、且在什么距离上如此。主要结论是：新加坡 1,925 家托儿中心呈强聚集，R = 0.552，而且这一格局通过了所施加的每一项检验。

Lesson 3 · Spatio-temporal point patterns第 3 讲 · 时空点格局

1 exercise

Adding time to the point pattern: spatio-temporal kernel density estimation and space-time K-functions, applied to forest fire detections in Kepulauan Bangka Belitung, Indonesia.给点格局加上时间维：时空核密度估计与时空 K 函数，应用于印度尼西亚邦加勿里洞群岛的森林火点探测数据。

Lessons 4 – 5 · Spatial weights and autocorrelation第 4 – 5 讲 · 空间权重与自相关

4 exercises

Four ways of deciding which areas count as neighbours, then the global and local statistics built on that decision: Moran's I and Geary's C against both an analytical and a permutation null, LISA cluster maps, and Getis-Ord Gi* hot and cold spots across Hunan's 88 counties.四种判定「谁是邻居」的方式，以及建立在这一判定之上的全局与局部统计量：Moran's I 与 Geary's C 同时对照解析零分布与置换零分布，LISA 聚类图，以及湖南 88 个县上的 Getis-Ord Gi* 热点与冷点。

Lesson 6 · Spatially constrained clustering第 6 讲 · 带空间约束的聚类

2 exercises

Regionalisation with Ward, SKATER and ClustGeo, and the price of requiring contiguity measured rather than argued: 26 percentage points of attribute homogeneity on the Shan State data. Emerging hot spot analysis over a seventeen-year space-time cube.用 Ward、SKATER 与 ClustGeo 做区域化，并把「要求连片」的代价测出来而不是争论出来：在掸邦数据上是 26 个百分点的属性同质性。另有十七年时空立方体上的新兴热点分析。

Lesson 7 · Geographically weighted models第 7 讲 · 地理加权模型

2 exercises

Letting a coefficient vary over space. Geographically weighted summary statistics first, then a hedonic pricing model for 1,436 condominium resales whose OLS residuals are spatially autocorrelated and whose adjusted R² rises from 0.647 to 0.856 under GWR.让系数随空间变化。先是地理加权汇总统计，再是 1,436 笔公寓转售的特征价格模型——其 OLS 残差存在空间自相关，改用 GWR 后调整后 R² 从 0.647 升到 0.856。

Lessons 8 – 10第 8 – 10 讲

Ahead

Geographically weighted predictive models, and spatial interaction and accessibility modelling.地理加权预测模型，以及空间交互与可达性建模。

How this site is built本站是怎么搭的

Q

Quarto

Every page is a .qmd document. Code, output and commentary live in one file, so nothing shown here was pasted in by hand. The figures are rendered from the code above them.每一页都是一个 .qmd 文档。代码、输出与说明同处一个文件，所以这里展示的任何东西都不是手工粘贴进来的，图都由其上方的代码渲染而成。

R

R 4.5.2

All analysis runs locally and is frozen with freeze: auto, so a published result is reproducible from the exact code beside it.全部分析在本地运行，并以 freeze: auto 冻结，因此发布出来的结果都能由紧邻它的那段代码复现。

▲

Vercel

The rendered site is committed and deployed on push, from github.com/imgigi/626.渲染好的站点随提交推送部署，源自 github.com/imgigi/626。
